$comment: Micro-event deck. Drawn per visit, weighted by realm, resonance, night and diary keywords.

events.text: A bus stops; nobody gets off.
A vending machine hums a lullaby, then dispenses a moon.
All the laundry lines wave at once, though there is no wind.
Every window lights up in order, down the street.
Three cats cross the road in a perfect line.
A phone booth rings and rings.
The prisms hum a chord together.
A rainbow slides along the floor like a slow animal.
All the candles lean toward you.
A glass figure kneels, then is gone.
A sentence falls from the sky, letter by letter.
A dune rewrites itself into a different word.
The great tablet blinks.
A red kite crosses the sky with no string.
A second moon rises next to the first.
A night train passes overhead, lit and empty.
Every object in the realm turns to face the same way.
An ice-cream van plays a tune you almost know, very slowly.
Every front door on the street opens at once.
A swing moves by itself in a yard with no swing set.
The streetlights dim and brighten like breathing.
Letters fly out of a mailbox and settle like birds.
One long organ note with no organ.
The pews have quietly turned to face you.
Light shafts swim across the floor like slow fish.
Coloured glass falls upward from the floor.
A bell rings somewhere above the windows.
A letter-cactus blooms into a whole sentence.
The wind spells your figure's name in sand.
A house from the suburb stands in the dunes, then is gone.
A pool of ink reflects a daytime sky.
A line of the great tablet erases itself.
A line of lantern-folk walks past, single file, not looking at you.
A clock strikes thirteen somewhere.
Three snowflakes fall, then stop.
A ringed planet opens and closes once.
A ringed planet turns to face you.
A ringed planet hums your night's theme.
A ringed planet lets go of a letter that drifts upward.
A cloud sheep glows the colour of your accent.
A cloud sheep repeats itself, a little further away.
A cloud sheep is suddenly much older.
A cloud sheep casts a rainbow shadow.
